governance_note: Document precision, tolerance, equality tests, cancellation risk, and rounding assumptions.
Report problem sensitivity using condition estimates and singular-value diagnostics where available.
State norm choice or approximation method and interpret high values cautiously.
Report residual and relative residual for solves, least-squares fits, and iterative outputs.
Use solver methods matched to matrix structure, sparsity, rank, conditioning, and accuracy needs.
Document row, column, variable, unit, and feature scaling and connect outputs back to original units.
Assess output sensitivity under small input, coefficient, scenario, or tolerance changes.
Communicate numerical limits alongside uncertainty, assumptions, and model-purpose boundaries.
